minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the 6 MW Northfield Road solar hearing to Sept 25 for decommissioning, buffering and pilot answers.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed an ANR plan, granted two site plan waivers, closed the hearing on and approved the Pioneer Drive expansion with conditions. Most of the night went to the large solar array at Northfield Road, where members pressed the applicant on decommissioning surety, buffering, fire response, interconnection and a tax agreement. The hearing was continued, and director's items and minutes were mostly deferred or brief.

public_comment.topic: Golf course co-owner supports the ANR division and parcel swap that puts the ninth fairway back on golf course land.
Abutter on New West Townsend Road objects to solar panels in view, tree cutting, drainage, wildlife and EMF; submitted a state guidance booklet.
Abutter says he does not oppose the project but wants evergreen buffering, access road moved to protect large trees, and worries about drainage.
Landowner explains the project funds the golf course long term, agrees to use the existing driveway, and says he contacted neighbors.

votes.motion: Grant the waivers from site plan review for the 84 Lakefront Avenue patio as presented.
Grant the waiver for Walker Orthodontics at 119 Massachusetts Avenue.
Close the public hearing on 40 Pioneer Drive and 98 Leominster Shirley Road.
Approve the Pioneer Drive plan with fire connections, hydrant, existing driveway kept during construction, and construction hours 7-6 Mon-Fri, 7-4 Sat, none Sundays or holidays.
Have staff send a letter to the zoning board supporting the third driveway at Pioneer Drive.
Continue the 994 Northfield Road solar hearing to September 25 at 6:30 p.m.
Table the director's item on definitions to a future meeting.
Approve minutes of the 8/14 meeting as edited.

decisions.decision: The solar applicant was asked to return with a firmer decommissioning cost estimate, alternate surety proposal, stronger buffering, visual simulations, neighbor outreach, and answers on fire response, interconnection and the PILOT.
Director's item on definitions deferred to a future meeting due to the hour.
Minutes to be corrected to show a member's vote as nay rather than abstain on the earlier vote.
Board agreed to ask staff to send a support letter for the third driveway variance.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the large-scale solar hearing at 994 Northfield Road to September 25 at 6:30 p.m., with questions still open.
Members asked the solar applicant to return with a firmer decommissioning cost estimate, an alternate surety proposal, stronger buffering and visual simulations.
The board also wants answers on fire response, interconnection and the PILOT tax agreement, which is still being negotiated with the town.
The board closed the hearing on 40 Pioneer Drive and 98 Leominster Shirley Road, then approved the Pioneer Drive plan with conditions.
The board granted site plan waivers for the 84 Lakefront Avenue patio and for Walker Orthodontics, and deferred the director's item on definitions.

why_it_matters: The solar array's decommissioning surety and PILOT terms decide who pays to remove the panels and how much tax revenue the town budget, mostly taxes, receives from the site.
Neighbors near Northfield Road and New West Townsend Road still have a chance to comment on buffering, drainage and views before the board decides.
watch_next: Continued public hearing on the 994 Northfield Road solar project, September 25 at 6:30 p.m.
The applicant's revised decommissioning estimate and surety proposal, and the PILOT terms under negotiation with the town.
